BUT: frozen D7 authority (src/benchmark/wp2/full144/population.py ordered_membership_hash()) computes 8eb4a724 over the ORDERED 144 VALIDATION-UNIT ids (verified: sha256(json.dumps(144 unit ids, separators=(',',':'))) == 8eb4a724). It is NOT over 219 task ids.

P2's serialization (UTF-8 JSON array, deterministic compact representation, separators=(',',':')) matches population.py's canonical json.dumps(...separators=(',',':')) exactly; the object being hashed is the ONLY open question.

RESOLUTION NEEDED (owner/binding record): either (a) ordered_task_ids_sha256 = sha256 over the 219 ordered TASK ids (new hash, NOT 8eb4a724), or (b) binding reuses frozen 8eb4a724 (144 unit ids) with an explicit note that the field name is task-level but the hash is unit-level.
